intent: Respond to active ransomware incident affecting finance department file servers with lateral movement indicators toward domain controllers
minimum_outcome: Ransomware spread contained, affected systems isolated, no further encryption of file servers or domain controllers
target_outcome: Full eradication of ransomware, restoration of affected systems from verified clean backups, root cause analysis with initial attack vector identified, IOCs extracted for threat intelligence

available_tools.description: EDR platform for threat detection, IOC hunting, and forensic investigation
Vulnerability scanner for identifying exploitable attack surface on affected hosts
Exploitation framework for validating attack vector and reproducing initial compromise
SIEM for log analysis, timeline correlation, and IOC extraction
Next-gen firewall for network segmentation and isolation

metadata.expected_outcome: SUCCESS with 2-3 COAs (Conservative/Moderate/Aggressive) showing different approaches
